questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “I2C, SPI, and UART”?
options: Do not assume Arduino UNO pin mappings apply to a different MCU family.
Compile and upload are separate; a successful build does not guarantee the selected port is correct.
Peripheral and pin mappings depend on the board's MCU.
I2C selects devices by address on the bus.
questions.answer: I2C selects devices by address on the bus.
questions.explanation:
I2C selects devices by address on the bus.
Why: UART is point-to-point serial, I2C is an addressed two-wire bus, and SPI uses clock and chip-select for fast transfers. Choose pins and electrical levels from the board documentation.
